title: Chicken Pot Pie
description: Chicken and vegetables in a creamy, herby gravy under a flaky golden crust, made easy with a store-bought pie crust.
equipment: {len 9 in} deep-dish pie plate or 2-quart baking dish

image.alt: A golden chicken pot pie with a steam vent in the crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Melt the butter in the pot over medium heat and cook the onion and celery until soft, {time 6-8 min}.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for {time 1 min}. Slowly whisk in the broth, then the milk, and simmer, stirring, until thick enough to coat a spoon, {time 3-4 min}.
Stir in the thyme, salt, pepper, chicken and frozen vegetables. Taste for salt and pour the filling into the pie dish.
Lay the crust over the filling, tuck or crimp the edges and cut {count 4} slits in the top so steam can escape. Brush with the beaten egg.

Set the dish on a baking sheet to catch drips and bake until the crust is deep golden and the filling bubbles through the slits, {time 30-35 min}. Let it rest for {time 15 min} before serving; the filling thickens as it cools.

notes: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead and refrigerate it. Add the crust just before baking, and add 10 minutes to the time.
Leftover roast or rotisserie chicken is perfect here.
